settings.label: The Beginning
settings.pull_quote: Golf has a front of house and a back of house. Almost everything gets pointed at the front.
settings.body:
Behind The Greens started as a simple idea: point the camera the other way. Follow the crews who are out on the course before the gates open — mowing lines at first light, setting pins, reading turf like a language only they speak. Talk to the superintendents who carry the whole operation on their shoulders. Show the culture, the routines, the unwritten rules that never make it into a broadcast.

That perspective found an audience fast — golfers and industry people alike, drawn to a side of the game they'd never really seen. What started as stories became a community, and that community wanted something to wear that actually represented it.

So we built one. Not golf merch. Not a landscaping brand. Apparel built in the same spirit as the stories — for the people who show up before the flag does, and everyone who respects them for it.

settings.title: The Crew Comes First
settings.text: Every story starts with the people doing the work, not the people playing the round.

settings.title: Culture Over Clichés
settings.text: No country-club stereotypes, no golf-themed gimmicks — just the real texture of the game.

settings.title: Built To Last
settings.text: Apparel made the way the work it represents deserves — solid, useful, not disposable.
A crest, not a logo — the kind of mark a crew earns, not one a marketing team invents. Every piece we make carries it.

settings.heading: One Story, Told A Few Different Ways
